_doc: The algorave lane's ONE sound registry (docs/algorave-livecoding-plan.md par.10: pack = data, not code). Read by validate.mjs (the gate: sound must be listed, and a .bank() must both exist here and carry that sound - a pair this matrix lacks plays SILENCE live), by agent/generative/strudel_mind.py (the palette and bank matrix in the prompt, per genre), and by the spike pages (sample registration from `sources`). Add sounds/banks HERE, never in code. To self-host samples, point `sources` at your own mirror - no code change. `banks` rows are extracted from the registered tidal-drum-machines.json (verified 2026-08-29). Three sound categories: `drums` (sample-backed, bank-prefixed - they REQUIRE the right .bank()), `synths` (oscillators, no samples at all) and `instruments` (sample-backed but NOT bank-prefixed: their map keys the sound name directly, so a .bank() on one resolves to nothing and plays silence). All three are equally 'a sound name that exists'; only the .bank() rule differs. Mirror gotcha: the b-cdn path for the VCSL map is case-sensitive - /VCSL/ resolves, /vcsl/ 404s, while the map itself is lowercase vcsl.json (verified 2026-08-30). The `roles` table (top-level REQUIRED, per-genre optional, per-field inheritance - the `instruments` rule) maps each melodic role to `voices` (ordered, first = the role's home sound; every voice must be a synth or instrument of the SAME scope, CI-fenced) and `octaves` [lo, hi], its register. Prompt-side data ONLY: the mind renders it (roles_block); the validator requires the field's presence but gates none of it - an event cannot be attributed to a role.
